name: Virtual Machine Manager
tagline: A GTK Broadway web UI for libvirt and virt-manager.
description: A GTK Broadway web UI for libvirt and virt-manager, to run virtual machines using QEMU/KVM.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  virt-manager:
    restart: always
    devices:
      - /dev/kvm:/dev/kvm
    environment:
      DARK_MODE: "false"
      HOSTS: "['qemu:///system']"
    image: mber5/virt-manager:latest
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /var/run/libvirt/libvirt-sock
        target: /var/run/libvirt/libvirt-sock
      - type: bind
        source: /var/lib/libvirt
        target: /var/lib/libvirt
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads
        target: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads
    container_name: virt-manager
